notes:
Account snapshot: Sundial Stratus Platform (mid-market B2B SaaS, product analytics). Evaluating Redwood Hosted first (quick POC) then moving to Dedicated for production. Primary sponsor: CTO (Liam Ortega). Procurement owner: VP of Platform (Nina Shah).

Recent timeline (high level):
- 2025-11-20: initial inbound via website trial; created account. AE assigned (Avery).
- 2025-12-05: Hosted API POC kickoff - basic chat + embeddings workflows. Fireflies: ff_2025-12-05_POC_Kickoff.
- 2026-01-14: Hosted API demo (2-hour): realtime chat latency 120-180ms p95, embeddings indexing test. Good perf vs baseline.
- 2026-01-21: Internal tech review; asked about dedicated throughput and private VPC.
- 2026-02-12: Onsite/remote workshop with SE (Jordan Lee). Discussed Dedicated sizing and quantization trade-offs. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-12_TeamCall_8345.
- 2026-02-20: 30-day Hosted POC concluded; sent usage report and cost model. Observed 1.2M tokens/day at peak for enrichment jobs.
- 2026-02-25: Dedicated pricing proposal v2 sent (drive:/deals/sundial-stratus/dedicated_pricing_v3.pdf).
- 2026-03-01: Commercial call to discuss commit, burst, overage mechanics and ramp schedule.

POC / technical notes:
- Workloads: mixed; realtime support chat (low latency p95 target <200ms for short responses), nightly large-batch embeddings (throughput prioritized), reranking for search queries.
- Observed token distribution: 70% short chat (<200 tokens), 30% long indexing (2k-8k tokens). KV-cache hit around 25% on recent tests.
- Model preference: open-model family with quantization supported; want deterministic fallbacks for tail latency (canary to smaller-context model).
- Networking: require VPC peering and static egress IPs; SSO + SAML for console access.

Pricing / Dedicated negotiation (current state):
- Proposal from Redwood (v2): 12-month Dedicated commitment. Base commit = $75k/month (covers baseline capacity: 4 reserved GPU nodes, sustained throughput ~1800 tokens/s aggregate).
- Ramp schedule proposed: Month 1-3 at 50% of commit (grace period while migrating workloads), Month 4-6 at 75%, Month 7+ at 100% commit. Customer requests explicit ramp language in contract to avoid early overage charges.
- Burst allowance: included burst pool up to 2x committed capacity for up to 72 hours/month at no additional immediate charge; bursts beyond that priced at overage rate.
- Overage pricing: 1.8x base per-unit price. Customer asked for 1.4x cap for first 6 months; Redwood finance preparing counter.
- Commitment flex: option to increase commit quarterly with 30-day notice; decreases only once per 6-month window with partial credit adjustments.
- Ramp credits: Redwood offered one-time ramp credit equal to 25% of first 3 months' invoice to offset migration cost - favorable, but legal wants this spelled out.
- Contract addendum requests from customer: data residency clause (US-only), audit log export cadence, KMS integration notes.

Customer feedback & quotes:
- CTO (Liam Ortega): "We like the predictable throughput and the cache behavior - but we need clear guardrails so spike traffic doesn't blow the first quarter budget."
- VP Platform (Nina Shah): "If you can give a predictable ramp with a limited overage cap, I can get this in front of procurement next week."

Internal win-criteria (Sundial):
- Latency p95 for chat <200ms under normal load; nightly embedding batch windows finish within 4 hours.
- Overage exposure limited/capped first two quarters.
- Legal signoff on US-only residency + SOC2 attestation and KMS flow.

Next steps (action items):
- AE (Avery) to circulate redline-friendly term sheet with specific ramp schedule and overage cap options by 2026-03-07.
- SE (Jordan) to produce Dedicated sizing diagram + expected throughput numbers for 50/75/100% commit within 2 business days. Attach to drive doc.
- Finance to produce counter that limits overage multiplier to 1.5x for first 6 months; propose tiered reduction thereafter.
- Legal: review data residency addendum; customer to provide existing DPA template.

Blockers (short):
- Legal needs explicit residency + audit export cadence.
- Customer wants lower overage multiplier for initial ramp.
- Final sign-off pending VP finance approval (budget cycle 2026-03).

CRM-style notes (fragments / quick):

- Wants canary fallback plan documented for model downgrades.
- SE suggested quantized 4-bit variant for embedding jobs to reduce cost ~30%.
- Keep Hosted account live as fallback until Dedicated cutover.
